reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Hospital Inclusive Charges Policy, Facility - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: For UB04 facility claims, routine services are bundled into room and board, facility, or ancillary charges and are not separately reimbursed; facility-owned ventilator or CPAP management is considered for reimbursement at one unit per day.

recommended_action.description: IA — In CA, remediate 'Not Mapped' cesarean-related UnitedHealthcare facility claims before any policy rollout by crosswalking UB04 inpatient facility claims and outpatient facility claims that bill revenue codes 250, 260-269, 270-279, 300-370, 361, and 391 into the correct facility buckets; for ventilator or CPAP management, keep payment only when it is on the same claim, tied to a facility-owned ventilator or CPAP, and limited to 1 unit per day. (CA)
